formulas.name: errorMsgForNtoBV
formulas.expression: "This Opportunity is missing required Contact Role(s). Before advancing to Booking Verification, ensure the following roles exist: " & IF({!billingCount} = 0, "Billing Contact", "") & IF({!billingCount} = 0 && ({!corrCount} = 0 || {!serviceCount} = 0), ", ", "") & IF({!corrCount} = 0, "Correspondence Contact", "") & IF({!corrCount} = 0 && {!serviceCount} = 0, ", ", "") & IF({!serviceCount} = 0, "Service Contact", "")

formulas.name: errorMsgQtS
formulas.expression: "This Opportunity is missing required Contact Role(s). Before advancing to Solutioning, ensure the following roles exist: " & IF({!poCount} = 0, "Business Process/Problem Owner", "") & IF({!poCount} = 0 && ({!champCount} = 0 || ({!edmCount} = 0 && {!ebCount} = 0)), ", ", "") & IF({!champCount} = 0, "Champion", "") & IF({!champCount} = 0 && ({!edmCount} = 0 && {!ebCount} = 0), ", ", "") & IF({!edmCount} = 0 && {!ebCount} = 0, "Economic Decision Maker or Economic Buyer", "")
